test.query: SELECT count() FROM zeros(100000000) WHERE NOT ignore(rand() % 2 ? 'hello' : 'world')
SELECT count() FROM numbers(100000000) WHERE NOT ignore(multiIf(number % 5 = 0, 'five', number % 3 = 0, 'three', 'other'))
SELECT count() FROM numbers(100000000) WHERE NOT ignore(transform(number % 10, [2, 4, 6], ['google', 'yandex', 'yahoo'], 'other'))
SELECT number % 1000 = 0 ? 'a' : 'b' AS x, count() FROM numbers(100000000) GROUP BY x FORMAT Null
SELECT transform(number % 10, [2, 4, 6], ['google', 'yandex', 'yahoo'], 'other') AS x, count() FROM numbers(100000000) GROUP BY x FORMAT Null
